product_summary: Website kewalson.com (Delhi, Hauz Qazi, est. 1974) is an industrial PPE distributor/reseller. Published catalogue lines: hand protection (Ansell nitrile/PU/neoprene coated and disposable gloves), head protection (Karam safety helmets, bump caps, nape/ratchet refills), eye protection (3M and Karam goggles), foot protection (steel-toe leather safety shoes, PVC/rubber gumboots from Vaultex and Duckback), respiratory protection (3M N95/disposable masks), plus first aid kits and tapes. All items are branded third-party goods (Ansell, 3M, Karam, Vaultex, Duckback) sold under those brands.
role_hint: trader (authorized PPE distributor / reseller). Self-description: 'Authorized PPE Distributor', 'tied up with various national and international manufacturers' — no own manufacturing line, no own brand found on site.
comment: HS mapping: declared 611610 and 640340 are corroborated by the catalogue (coated knitted work gloves; leather safety footwear with steel toe) — exact. 650610 is corroborated (safety helmets) — exact. 420329 (leather gloves) is plausible for a PPE trader but no distinct leather-glove line appears in the published catalogue — заявлено, не подтверждено. Declaration is INCOMPLETE: missing 401519 (rubber/neoprene chemical gloves), 392620 (disposable nitrile gloves), 640199/640192 (PVC gumboots), 900490 (goggles), 63079099 (respirators/masks) — all clearly present on the site. Industry misclassification: declared 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is WRONG — the company is industrial safety equipment / PPE, no food or FMCG products anywhere on the site. Trader signs: multi-brand reseller catalogue, no manufacturing claims, retail e-shop with MRP/discount pricing, single Delhi market address with branch offices — consistent with a distributor, not a producer. No customs lines were available to me, so no product line here is confirmed as an actual shipment; all catalogue items are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. Per rule 3, the HS/industry mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, industry corrected to PPE/industrial safety, HS list corrected as above.
